title: Industrialize model-onboarding: cost/latency bucketizer & decision playbook
creator: Priya Singh
description: Problem: Enterprise buyers are overwhelmed by model variant choices (families, quantization, hw affinity, license). Sales and onboarding teams need an operational 'bucketizer' that maps customer constraints (latency SLO, budget, on-prem vs hosted) to 2–3 recommended model+profile options and an explicit fallback plan. Goal: create a reproducible scoring index and prescriptive playbook that product, solutions, and sales can use during procurement and onboarding. Deliver a lightweight scoring algorithm, a canonical CSV mapping for common archetypes, a prototype dashboard for exploration, and an internal playbook with negotiation guidance and rollout templates.
tasks: Competitive scan: catalog how 6 competitors present model choices and pricing (public docs + sales snippets)
Define scoring dimensions and weights: latency median/95, tokens-per-dollar, memory footprint, quantization-compatibility, license constraints, privacy (VPC/on-prem friendliness)
Interview run: conduct 8 customer onboarding interviews and 4 solutions-engineer debriefs to validate archetypes and thresholds
Data collection: assemble benchmark matrix (realistic seq lengths: 64/256/1024) across 5 model families and 3 infra configs
Prototype algorithm: implement bucketizer (simple rule + weighted score) producing top-3 recommendations per archetype
Dashboard: build an exploratory Looker/Metabase prototype with filterable archetypes and cost/latency tradeoff curves
Playbook write-up: negotiation prompts, security checklist items, suggested fallbacks and canary cadence for model switches
Stakeholder review: 1x PM review, 1x Solutions Eng review, 1x Sales readout session
Hand-off: package CSV + infra benchmark results + short demo recording for onboarding team
acceptance_criteria: Scoring spec doc published in Confluence with dimension definitions and rationale
CSV mapping covering at least 6 buyer archetypes with top-3 model+profile recommendations
Prototype dashboard that can visualize cost vs latency for selected models and sequence lengths
Playbook with step-by-step onboarding script, fallbacks, and a canary rollout template
Stakeholder sign-off from Solutions Eng and Sales recorded in ticket comments
Example runbook entries for console alerts that should trigger fallback/downscale actions
